content_metadata.description: Join Tamica Smith and her esteemed guests, Harry McCumber and Jonathan Barlow, as they delve into the intricacies of worker compensation, Jones Act, and Longshore claims. This episode offers valuable legal insights for those injured on the job, ensuring viewers become well-informed about their rights and the legal frameworks that protect them.
